title: M1 test ground
description: Procedural, deterministic test ground for the P2/M1 first test drive. This file covers the meshed static features (straight, skidpad, grass/dirt patches, a split-mu strip, ramps at 5/10/15/30/50%, a side slope, a small circuit, a 10 km top-speed straight and an airstrip); the surrounding 100 x 100 km world is procedural terrain, see terrain.json. Every feature here sits on one of terrain.json's flat zones, so none of it depends on the noise height function. See PLAN.md section 'M1 -- First test drive' and data/tracks/README.md.
frame: World frame: local east-north-up (x=east, y=north, z=up), metres, radians (yaw_deg/pitch_deg in degrees for readability) -- algebraically the same as a vehicle's own ISO 8855 frame (x forward, y left, z up); the world is oriented so the main spawn's forward is due east. Origin (0,0,0) is the main spawn point, at the centre of terrain.json's main flat disc.
